correctness.rationale: The exact unitary Zak multiplier is the sum of two critical-window symbols. Poisson summation gives the stated rational fiber. A strictly positive derivative in cos(2πx) fixes global x extrema, and strict convexity of the pair of hyperbolic-square angular profiles determines global minima and maxima, attained at explicitly listed fibers. Direct checker replay supports all algebraic steps; numerical grids are not treated as infinite proof. Width, frequency spacing, Fourier normalization and endpoint limits are explicit.
